d:
When a person invents something so pivotal that it changes the course of human history and trillion dollar companies are build on top of your creation, you'd probably be shocked when you hear that the inventor gave it away for free. That's exactly what Sir Tim Berners-Lee did when he invented the web. In this episode we check out why how he invented the web and why he gave it all away for free.
